papers.title: Crack-free selective laser melting of silica glass: single beads and monolayers on the substrate of the same material

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Moscow State University of Technology “STANKIN”, Vadkovsky per. 3a, 127055, Moscow, Russia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是二氧化硅玻璃的选区激光熔化，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力屏蔽、疲劳等方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on glass processing, not metallic biomedical implants, and does not cover porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现二氧化硅玻璃的无裂纹选区激光熔化
summary_zh.method: 在相同材料基底上制备单珠和单层样品
summary_zh.result: 成功获得无裂纹玻璃样品
summary_zh.validation: 通过单珠和单层形貌观察验证

summary_en.motivation: To achieve crack-free selective laser melting of silica glass, which is challenging due to its brittleness.
summary_en.method: Single beads and monolayers were fabricated on a substrate of the same silica glass material.
summary_en.result: Crack-free silica glass samples were successfully obtained.
summary_en.validation: Validation was done by observing the morphology of single beads and monolayers.
